title: Trump Imposes Limited Tariffs on Foreign Semiconductors
summary: The tariffs will allow President Trump to take a cut of Nvidia’s chip sales to China while putting off a decision about imposing higher taxes on the chip industry.

title: Iran Postpones Execution of Protester as Trump Threatens ‘Strong Action’
summary: Iran had planned to put a 26-year-old protester to death amid the wave of unrest in the country, but stood down for now, his family and human rights group said.

title: Grok was finally updated to stop undressing women and children, X Safety says
summary: California's AG will investigate whether Musk’s nudifying bot broke US laws.

title: Cameroon football suspends president Samuel Eto’o for alleged misbehaviour
summary: Former international forward Samuel Eto'o has been suspended for his alleged behaviour during Cameroon's AFCON exit.
